name: Clicky

evidence.web: F02: primary category is website analytics; F15: real-time visits, referrers, countries, devices and UTM campaigns

line: Real-time website analytics for visits, actions and conversions.

pv.math: 10,000 pageviews is within the free plan's soft limit of 90,000 a month.
100,000 pageviews fit within the Pro plan's soft limit of 900,000 a month.
1,000,000 pageviews fit within the Pro Platinum plan's soft limit of 3,000,000 a month.
